capabilities.body: OpenAmer planuyet zadachu, vypolnyayet yeyo realnymi instrumentami — terminalom, brauzerom, faylami, kodom — i sokhranyayet to, chto srabotalo.
capabilities.title: Agent, kotoryy dumayet vmeste s vami

capabilities.body: Razgovory, pamyat i modeli nahodyatsya na etoy mashine. Nichyego ne zagruzhayetsya bez vashego zaprosa.
capabilities.title: Vashe zhelezo, vashi dannye

capabilities.body: 186 yazykov, kazhdyy na tom pis'me, kotorym vy pol'zuyetes'. Na pervom ekrane prilozheniya nuzhno vybrat' yazyk.
capabilities.title: Vash yazyk, pravil'no

capabilities.body: Navyki sokhranyayutsya v protsesse raboty, poetomu povsednevnye zadachi stanovyatsya koroche s vremenem.
capabilities.title: Vozrastayushchaya vozmozhnost'

help: Prover'te, imeyet li eta mashina dostup k internetu.
Zapustite ustanovku snova — zavershennye shagi ne povtoryayutsya.
Yesli oshibka povtoritsya dvizhy, otkroyte logi; v poslednih strokah ukazana etapa.
failure.lead: Nikakie izmeneniya ne byli otmeneny tikhon'ko — OpenAmer ostanovilsya tam, gde proizoshel sboy, poetomu povtornyy zapusk prodolzhitsya s etogo mesta.
failure.leadUpdate: OpenAmer ostayetsya na predydushchey versii i prodolzhayet rabotat'. Nichyego ne bylo zameneno chastichno.
failure.title: Ustanovka ne zavershena

language.lead: Ustanovka prodolzhitsya na yazyke, kotoryy vy vyberete zdes'. Vy mozhete izmenit' yego pozheye v prilozhenii.
language.title: Vyberite vash yazyk

progress.lead: Ednorazovaya ustanovka: OpenAmer zagruzhayet neobkhodimye dannye i konfiguriruyet etu mashinu. Sleduyushchie zapuski proputyat etot etap.
progress.leadUpdate: OpenAmer zamenyayet predydushchuyu versiyu. Vashi sessii, pamyat' i nastroyki ostayutsya neizmennymi.
progress.title: Ustanovka OpenAmer

cards.body: Otkroyte prilozheniye i opishite, chto nuzhno sdelat'. OpenAmer rabotayet v fone i otpravlyayet otchety.
cards.title: Nachnite s predlozheniya

cards.body: Nastroyki → Ekran → Yazyk. 186 lokalizatsiy, dostupnykh dlya pereklucheniya v lyuboy moment.
cards.title: Vyberite vash yazyk

cards.body: Povtoryayushchayasya rabota stanovitsya navykom — v sleduyushchiy raz potrebuetsya odna komanda.
cards.title: Pozvol'te yemu pomnit'

success.command: ili zapustite yego pozheye iz terminala:
success.lead: Vsyo gotovo. OpenAmer teper' vash — na etoy mashine, na vashem yazyke.
success.title: OpenAmer gotov

bullets: Rabotayet lokal'no — vashi razgovory ostayutsya na etoy mashine
186 yazykov, vklyuchaya pis'mo, kotorym vy pol'zuyetes'
Vsyo mozhno izmenit' pozheye; nichego ne yavlyayetsya postoyannym
welcome.lead: Vash sobstvennyy agent. Na vashem zheleze. Na vashem yazyke.
welcome.leadUpdate: Gotova novaya versiya OpenAmer. Ona zamenit predydushchuyu versiyu i sokhranit vse sessii i nastroyki.
welcome.note: Zaymet neskol'ko minut pri obychnom podklyuchenii.
welcome.title: Dobro pozhalovat' v OpenAmer
